criteria.text: A simulated ransomware encryption on a test share is detected and the client blocked within minutes, and the files are restored
criteria.how: Run a safe encryption simulator against a test share and time detection, blocking and restore.

criteria.text: A user restores yesterday's version of a file without opening a ticket
criteria.how: Ask one user to restore a file through previous versions.

criteria.text: The audit answers who deleted a given folder and when, in under five minutes
criteria.how: Delete a test folder, then find the user and time in the audit.

criteria.text: Shares open to everyone are listed with their owners, and the list is agreed with the business
criteria.how: Run the permission review on two departments and review it with them.

criteria.text: Cold data moves to cheaper storage with no change for users, and the saving is shown
criteria.how: Tier one share and open its old files from a client.
